blind.description: A stylized wooden prie-dieu (prayer kneeler desk). It consists of a low step with a padded dark red/burgundy cushion for kneeling, a central vertical paneled riser with carved trim details, and an upper slanted shelf/ledge intended for resting prayer books or hands with raised side rails. The surfaces are continuous, clean, and solid with stylized hand-painted wood grain texture.
blind.from_above: A rectangular composition showing the slanted wooden book rest at the top with protruding side caps, stepped down to the lower dark red rectangular padded kneeler framed in wood.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall), and approximately 2.5 feet wide.
